text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And claiming victory at the Arima Kinen is none other than Yamanin Zephyr! It's Yamanin Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Does distance mean nothing in the face of the true wind?!
Yamanin Zephyr has achieved a terrifying four-division sweep!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, geez, I'm gonna win this, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm really frustrated, honestly. No matter how much I ran, I just couldn't catch up to you—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Indeed, she truly is like the wind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't a compliment! I'm complaining!
Geez.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry to say, but after being shown a gust of wind like that—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't just say "forget it."
...Please run with me again, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'm definitely going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Anytime, as many times as you like, I'll take you on.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Because the wind is meant to keep blowing—
